result.title: Bayesian $κ$-Explorer for Minimax Model Estimation in MDPs
result.summary: We study active exploration for minimax transition estimation in unknown Markov decision processes (MDPs). Frequentist $κ$-Explorer~\citep{gu2026kappa} addresses this problem through a parameterized family of exploration objectives, but requires confidence-bound constructions and joint optimization over plausible transition kernels and occupancy measures, introducing a computational burden that limits its practical applicability. We develop Bayesian $κ$-Explorer, which simplifies this procedure by placing Dirichlet priors on the transition distributions. Under the posterior mean estimator, the posterior expected squared $\ell_2$ error equals the total posterior variance, providing a closed-form exploration signal. The algorithm plans under the posterior mean model, eliminating confidence-set optimization. Under the stated assumptions, this simpler planning procedure retains the $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/3})$ surrogate convergence rate of frequentist $κ$-Explorer. We further bound the maximum posterior variance relative to the optimal asymptotic minimax allocation benchmark. Experiments on Pendulum, Mountain Car, and Taxi demonstrate lower worst-case transition-estimation errors than the tested baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Bayesian κ-Explorer：在 MDP 转移分布上放置 Dirichlet 先验，以事后均值为估计器，使后验期望平方误差等于总后验方差，从而得到闭式探索信号，规划时无需置信集联合优化；在给定假设下保留原方法的收敛率与后验方差界，并在 Pendulum、Mountain Car、Taxi 上降低最坏情形转移估计误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用后验方差构成闭式信息获取目标，可能为 LVR 中「何时继续 LOOK、如何筛选视觉证据」的信息价值度量与主动取证策略提供可核查的类比线索，但属纯 MDP 探索理论，向多模态推理的迁移尚需核查。
